title: A shard on a compute host may start nested sandboxes, so a sandbox test runs and passes there
description: A merge trial with one ready compute host reached through graphyard-host-shim. tests/trial-runtime.test.ts, which runs a whole trial inside bubblewrap, is no longer local-only: its shard runs on the host, in a container with seccomp and system paths unconfined that keeps a read-only root, no capabilities, no new privileges, no network and its CPU, memory and process limits, and it passes.

steps.name: Run a trial whose one test file, tests/trial-runtime.test.ts, runs on the compute host
